|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Devaronian Uncle. The image is the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Vilmarh_Villie_Grahrk.png]]), which prints it. The later version [[Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk]] (PC-E1, the current card) has the same game text under the title •Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk.
* '''Original''' (this page): printed as “•Devaronian Uncle” on the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012), p. 3<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012), page 3, slip 13 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>, and listed under that title, with the same text, on the PC website card list from 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-old-villie">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual Block 8.2 cards are not in the archived Virtual Master list captures (the Virtual Block 8.2 cards first appear in the capture of 12 December 2012)</ref>: “[Pilot] 2. While present at Audience Chamber or stacked on your Objective: non-unique Devaronians are deploy -1, power and forfeit +1, and if Yerka Mig is about to be lost, may place it in Used Pile instead.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk]]): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Devaronian Uncle ---> Vilmarh ‘Villie’ Grahrk”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The title changed to “•Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-villie">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313222931/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-03-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429063548/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-04-29]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, PDF page 16)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=16, page 16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=16 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-13-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-vilmarhvilliegrahrk-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
